label: Waved albatross, animal 3275-30662
label_line: Recorded movements of one breeding adult, 23 June to 15 September 2008.
title: Galapagos Albatrosses (the study's name on Movebank)
place: Galápagos (tagged at Punta Cevallos, the source's site name) and the eastern Pacific towards Peru
method: GPS tag (e-obs, 22 g), a fix attempted every 90 minutes; read out wirelessly (reference file)
sample_sentence: One of 28 birds tagged; nine were used in the paper's analysis. These are sample sizes, not a population estimate.
time_convention: Times are as recorded by the study: UTC, or GPS time, which differs from UTC by a few leap seconds (source README). Mother Earth rounds each time to the nearest second.
location_uncertainty: the tag's own horizontal accuracy estimate per fix (the tag maker's estimate, not a measured error)
accuracy_note: Each displayed fix carries the tag's own accuracy estimate (median 4 m, largest 65 m among the 981 displayed). It is the tag's estimate, not a measured error.
citation_as_given: Cruz, S., Proaño, C.B., Anderson, D., Huyvaert, K., Wikelski, M., 2013, Data from: The Environmental-Data Automated Track Annotation (Env-DATA) System--Linking animal tracks with environmental data: Movebank Data Repository. doi:10.5441/001/1.3hp3s250
paper_citation_as_given: Dodge, S., Bohrer, G., Weinzierl, R., Davidson, S.C., Kays, R., Douglas, D., Cruz, S., Han, J., Brandes, D., Wikelski, M., 2013, The Environmental-Data Automated Track Annotation (Env-DATA) System--Linking animal tracks with environmental data: Movement Ecology, v. 1:3. doi:10.1186/2051-3933-1-3

source_file.name: Galapagos Albatrosses.csv
source_file.retrieved: downloaded by Chad on 20 Nov 2026 from the Movebank Data Repository record

reference_file.name: Galapagos Albatrosses-reference-data.csv
reference_file.retrieved: downloaded by Chad on 20 Nov 2026 from the same record

outlier_field: the source file has no manually-marked-outlier column; that is an absent field, not a statement that the source checked and found none

timestamp_rule.rounding: nearest whole second, in integer milliseconds: seconds = (ms + 500) div 1000
timestamp_rule.statement: Times are rounded to the nearest second. A source time more than 25 ms from a whole second stops the build.
timestamp_rule.applied: to every source row of the animal, positioned or not, before any omission

gap_rule.statement: Mother Earth does not join fixes more than 3 hours 15 minutes apart, and never joins across a withheld fix. These are display rules of Mother Earth's, not part of the study.
gap_rule.owner: Mother Earth (display rule; not supplied by the researchers)

withholding.boundary: a fix at exactly the radius or closer is withheld
withholding.centre_source: the reference file's deployment coordinates for this animal, as given (two decimals)
withholding.owner: Mother Earth (a project omission rule; not a scientifically established protection distance and not a guarantee of safety)
withholding.statement: Mother Earth withholds every fix within 5 km of the tagging-site reference point. That point is the reference file's deployment location, given to two decimals; it is a tagging-site reference, not a nest position.

simplification: filtered, not thinned or smoothed: fixes near the tagging site are withheld; every other recorded fix is in the display file
sensitivity: Release decision by the site owner, 21 Nov 2026: fixes within 5 km of the tagging-site reference point are withheld; every other recorded fix is shown at the source's precision; animal identifier only.

card.note: Recorded movements of one breeding adult, 23 June to 15 September 2008. A dated replay, not current.
card.shown: 981 of 1,326 recorded fixes are shown. 345 fixes within 5 km of the tagging-site reference point are withheld by Mother Earth.
card.done: Times are rounded to the nearest second. The line never crosses a withheld period. 10 joins span a time when the tag tried and got no position. 12 attempts got no position and are not drawn.
card.line: The line joins displayed fixes no more than 3 hours 15 minutes apart with no withheld fix between them: 966 of 980 steps.
card.not_route: The path between fixes was not observed. The line is not the bird's flight path.
card.changes: Changes made to the dataset (CC0 1.0): one bird selected; fixes near the tagging site withheld; times rounded to the nearest second; nothing moved, smoothed or interpolated. The archived source is unchanged.
card.accuracy: Each displayed fix carries the tag's own accuracy estimate (median 4 m, largest 65 m among the 981 displayed). It is the tag's estimate, not a measured error.
card.tagging: Tagged 23 Jun 2008 at Punta Cevallos (the source's site name); life stage as recorded: adult; the source's comment: “Nest stage: egg”; deployment comment: “used in analysis and shown in Figs 7-8”.
